routes.name: Temporary Stay Permit
routes.summary: Temporary permit for 3 months up to 1 year, renewable. Grounds include tourism, work, spouse or children, or cohabitation.

other: Official page did not give fees, income or full documents. Check esteri.sm or info@esteri.sm.

stay.note: Valid 3 months to 1 year, renewable at your request.

routes.name: Special Grounds Stay Permit
routes.summary: Temporary permit for study, sport, medical treatment, religion, humanitarian reasons, volunteering or working holiday schemes. Up to 12 months, renewable.

other: Partner countries for working holiday were not listed on the page. Official page did not give fees, income or full documents. Check esteri.sm or info@esteri.sm.

routes.name: Registered Residence
routes.summary: Long-term residence for family reunification with a San Marino citizen, starting a business, or holding a management role in a San Marino company.

other: Official page did not give fees, income or full documents. Check esteri.sm or info@esteri.sm.

sources.label: San Marino Foreign Affairs: stay permits, residence and citizenship

routes.name: Elective Residence (Investor)
routes.summary: For foreigners who make and keep a property or financial investment under San Marino law. Needs health insurance and no public sector work or state benefits.

other: Investment amount not on the page. Official page did not give fees, income or full documents. Check esteri.sm or info@esteri.sm.

sources.label: San Marino Foreign Affairs: stay permits, residence and citizenship

routes.name: Atypical Residence with Facilitated Tax Regime
routes.summary: For people moving to San Marino who earn income abroad and were not previously tax resident there. Needs health insurance, no public sector work, no state benefits.

other: Income threshold not on the page. Official page did not give fees, income or full documents. Check esteri.sm or info@esteri.sm.

sources.label: San Marino Foreign Affairs: stay permits, residence and citizenship

routes.name: Pensioners Atypical Residence
routes.summary: For EU and Swiss nationals (and others set by the government) with income from abroad. Same conditions as the atypical regime. Registered residence after 10 years.

other: Other eligible countries are set by a Congress of State regulation. Official page did not give fees, income or full documents. Check esteri.sm or info@esteri.sm.
